question: ______ is situated at the confluence of Alaknanda and Mandakini rivers.
solution:
__
 
• **Rudraprayag** is situated at the confluence of **Alaknanda and Mandakini** rivers.
 
• ***Panch Prayag:-***

**Both merge and become Ganga.**

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
• **__Alaknanda River:-__**
 
• Alaknanda is one of the two Major headstreams of Ganga River.
 
• The other headstream being the **Bhagirathi **River.
 
• According to Hindu mythology, Bhagirathi is considered the source of Ganga River.
 
• The Alaknanda rises at the confluence and foot of the **Satopanth and Bhagirath Kharak glaciers** in Uttarakhand.
 
• The five main tributaries joining with Alaknanda **in order** includes- 
 
 
• **Dhauliganga**, **Nandakini**, **Pindar**, **Mandakini** and **Bhagirathi** all rising in the northern mountainous regions of Uttarakhand
